journeys.name: Dinner party (make): saying yes to what was offered
journeys.$comment: From a real thread: the assistant offered a menu and a shopping list, the person said yes to both, and got them as text, then a question about which interface. Agreeing to an offer is asking for it, and each thing is made as its own interface.

journeys.name: Dinner party (make): content goes in interfaces, not the reply
journeys.$comment: Asked for a menu and a shopping list without a make verb: what a reply would write out goes in the interfaces that hold it.
